sections.Profile:
Nautilus, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in February 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with an underwater exploration theme. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, an eight-bank drop target, two standup targets, a kick-out hole, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sharks, Ocean, Fish, Scuba Diving, 1970s, Single level playfield
